axis_note: Blender side: X forward (robot front), Y left, Z up. Exporter axis_forward=-Z, axis_up=Y (same as chaser): Unreal maps it to X forward, Z up. Not verified in Unreal (nothing imported).

front_axis.note: the eye (red faces) lies on +X in Blender; the raw mesh faced -Y

eye.criterion: UV0 triangle covers a texel with linear saturate((R - 2 max(G,B)) x 3) > 0.1 (texel centres inside + texels of vertices and centroid) and face centroid inside the zone
eye.note: zone zmin 100, xmin 25: eyes only (83 faces, one component x31-38 y-11..13 z118-140); cannon glow (63 faces, x41-53 y-61..-39 z59-80) and 1 stray face (x2.5,y51,z133) stay in body; the 2255 red texels outside the zone are the cannon glow

lightmap_uv1.method: one island per face, shelf packed, bbox test

warnings: 2255 red texels (stray red spots, not the eye) stay in body faces outside the zone

cannon_tip.definition: centre of the cannon muzzle face (red glow cap, flat disc about 24 cm wide by 28 cm tall, normal about +X tilted 15 deg down), taken as the mean of the 51 vertices of the glow faces and cross-checked with the bbox centre of the glow faces (46.9,-50.0,69.4)
cannon_tip.convention: from the floor origin; Unreal X forward, Z up, Y = -Blender Y (Unreal +Y right). Not verified in Unreal (nothing imported). Accuracy about +-1.5 cm; the cannon is on the robots right side as seen from behind (Blender -Y).
